title: Connect WhatsApp
subtitle: How would you like to use your number?
appDescription: Use the number from your WhatsApp Business app.
appDetailOne: Keep using the Business app alongside {project}.
appDetailTwo: Messages from the app also reach the API.
appDetailThree: Meta will check whether your account is eligible.
dedicatedDescription: Set up a new or existing number just for {project}.
dedicatedDetailOne: Send and receive messages through the API, without the app.
dedicatedDetailTwo: Verify your number by text or phone call.
dedicatedDetailThree: You need admin access to your business in Meta.
appAuthorizationDescription: Authorize access to your current number.
dedicatedAuthorizationDescription: Authorize a number to use with the API.
stepOne: Sign in and choose your business.
dedicatedStepThree: Verify the number and authorize access.
appRequirement: Keep your phone handy. Meta will check your account's eligibility.
dedicatedRequirement: You need admin access and must be able to receive texts or calls on that number.
verifying: Verifying your number and completing the connection…
completeError: Could not complete the connection. Request a new link if you need to start again.
successDescription: You can close this page now.
missingAccount: Meta did not return a WhatsApp account. Check your Embedded Signup settings and try again.
cancelled: You cancelled setup in Meta. You can try again.
providerError: Meta reported a WhatsApp setup error. Check your permissions and Embedded Signup settings.
unavailable: This link is no longer available.
loadError: Could not load the options. Reload the page to try again.
sdkError: Could not load Meta. Check your connection or content blocker.
accountTimeout: Meta authorized access but did not confirm a WhatsApp account. Check your WhatsApp Embedded Signup settings and enabled products.
loginTimeout: Meta did not respond. Check whether your browser blocked the popup and try again.
authorizePrompt: Complete authorization in the Meta window.
authorized: Access authorized. Waiting for WhatsApp account confirmation…
noAuthorization: Authorization was not received. You can try again.
